description.zh: 查看项目血缘关系：哪个项目继承了哪个项目的成果（复制了多少文件），以树状文本返回；open=true 时同时在浏览器中打开血缘关系图。不填 project 看当前项目所在的血缘，填 "all" 看全部。
description.en: Show project lineage: which project built on which (and how many files were copied), as a text tree; with open=true also opens the lineage graph in the browser. Without project it shows the current project's lineage; "all" shows everything.

project.description: 项目名称或 id；留空 = 当前项目，"all" = 全部

open.description: 是否在浏览器中打开血缘关系图

project.description: project name or id; empty = the current project, "all" = every project

open.description: also open the lineage graph in the browser
